lines: Six in the evening. A new order went up, on the trench wall and on Instagram.
cold
Volunteers for the wire. Comment WIRE.
cold2
This is Front News. Day five.
ident
That night, sixty-seven men went out. Thirty-five Hegemony, thirty-two Concord.
party
They crawled out after dark, with coils of barbed wire and corkscrew posts that twist into the mud without a sound.
party2
The Hegemony put up five hundred and seventy-seven yards. The Concord, four hundred and eighty-two.
party3
Then the flares went up. Sixteen men were caught in the light.
flare
It was the last night of the guns on Verdel Ridge. Twenty-one men were hit. Seven were killed where they stood.
guns
By morning, much of the new wire was torn apart again. Without the wiring parties, it would have been down to nine percent.
guns2
The Hegemony had run out of room. Every bed was full. Twenty-four men lay on stretchers, and thirteen still lay in the trench.
ward
The medics could reach only four out of ten.
ward2
The day before, Felix Owenhart of the Concord had fallen. Now the next Owenhart, Edmund, was on the fire step.
shot
The bearers had just reached Dorian Coletonmarti. One shot, and it was over.
shot2
Day five cost the Hegemony nine dead. The Concord lost no one.
dead
Forty-seven new soldiers came up the line.
new
And the race for Hill 304 came down to the last few men. Ninety-seven to seventy-nine.
hill
Three more. That was all the Hegemony needed.
hill2
This was Front News. Next time: the hill falls.
out
